resources.string: Enter an HTTPS address you trust. With your approval, KX sends one HEAD request bound to this VPN network and checks fresh WireGuard handshake and traffic counters. No direct-network fallback. This does not prove public exit location, IPv6 connectivity, or absence of DNS leaks.
This request succeeded through the VPN network with a recent handshake and increased received/sent bytes.
No confirmed KX tunnel. Connect first.
This app is not using the VPN network. No verified VPN path.
The network changed during verification. Try again on a stable connection.
No recent WireGuard handshake was measured. Check the gateway and peer configuration.
WireGuard did not report increased traffic in both directions. The path is not verified.
The HTTPS endpoint did not return a successful status. The path is not verified.
Verification could not finish. Check the HTTPS address, network and gateway, then retry.
Configured default routes: IPv4 %1$s · IPv6 %2$s · DNS configured: %3$s. These are configuration observations, not leak-test results.
